title: ERP · Unified clinical workspace
brief: Self-contained Spanish staff ERP demo for fictional Clínica Dental Andina; no backend, credentials, external calls or persistence. T8/S37 implemented, current runtime GREEN and final independent verification pending; no whole-feature acceptance or native approval claim. Parent observed T8 HTTP RED job5 exit1/4s/50 passing checks on missing clinical text controls and structured fields. Human-selected diagnoses have diseaseId/name snapshot/optional notes; optional prescriptions have medicationId/name snapshot/required manual instructions. All clinical text is trimmed, literal and bounded to 2000 characters. New consultations start blank, with reference placeholders and no automatically inferred diagnoses, medicines, doses or recommendations. Separate Notas clínicas and Recomendaciones do not substitute for a selected diagnosis. Add/edit/remove changes only an isolated form draft, preserving other live fields/services; native edit Cancel/Escape does not mutate it. Guardar progreso persists the entire validated candidate atomically. Save/Complete explicitly rejects visible unadded input until Agregar or clearing; entries allocate no IDs. Completing requires motivo/anamnesis/exploración, a human-selected diagnosis and positive explicitly selected services; prescriptions/notes/recommendations remain optional. Closed records are read-only snapshots, stable after reference renames; saved open/closed references protect disease/medicine deletion. Clinical Save/Complete retain visible text and stable IDs; contextual Agregar + and spaced icon row controls reuse the shared presentation/dialog/tooltip adapters. Historical T7 passed HTTP2128/24 owned HTML loads/zero forbidden writes and page errors; this does not verify T8. Preserve T7 editable unique identity documents distinct from immutable patient IDs, actual-field table columns, free descriptive Lab/Imagen catalogs and clinical requests/results, independent Medicamentos CRUD and removal of obsolete Triage. Only selected Aranceles services become PROCEDIMIENTO order/receipt lines, never studies or medicines. The exact-cent 600.30 journey uses actual 300/100.10/200.20 services. Existing S29/S30 independent target-role Navigation, atomic permission/settings save, seventeen distinct menu SVGs and 8px gaps remain. Per-menu Acceder and allowed-only finance/agenda/clinical Resumen personalization are demo visibility, not backend authorization. Financial baseline 700/250/450/1400, outgoing Pagos, appointment lifecycle, cash/non-payable QR idempotence and immutable DEMO receipts are retained. Simulated no-credential login/logout resets all state. Existing screenshots are historical T7 captures; parent-owned current runtime, screenshot refresh, fresh independent proof and persistent-URL acceptance remain pending. No real medical care, payment, authentication/authorization, backend, storage or publication. Latest T8 author HTTP job6 GREEN: PASS2239/26 local HTML document loads/zero external/API/storage writes and page errors, desktop/mobile screenshots refreshed. Structured clinical draft/snapshot/billing checks pass. Final independent verification and actual delivered-URL acceptance remain pending.

artboards.title: Unified business workspace
artboards.tradeoff: One preserved sourced-light shell with structured human-only clinical documentation, isolated explicit-save drafts, name/text snapshots and reference protection. No automated diagnosis, dose, recommendation or medicine billing. Independent patient identity documents retain stable clinical links. Free study requests/results coexist with selected-service orders and cash/non-payable QR receipts. Navigation/content grants, allowed-only personalization, CRUD, focus/mobile controls and spacing remain. T8 implementation/static proof only; parent actual RED50 is recorded, GREEN and final independent verification remain pending. Historical T7 author2128 and prior independent60 are not approval of this material candidate. No whole-feature completion, native approval or production clinical/payment/security readiness is claimed.
